summary: Orange County Bancorp, Inc. (Nasdaq: OBT), parent of Orange Bank Trust Company and Orange Investment Advisors, filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing a quarterly cash dividend declaration of $0.18 per common share, payable September 15, 2026 to holders of record September 4, 2026. A press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. No board recommendation, advisor, acquisition, divestiture, tender, or structural transaction is disclosed; this is an ordinary capital-return declaration by the issuer, not a special situation, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
